files.description: 1 kHz sine, amplitude 0.00316 (~-50 dBFS peak), phase 0

files.name: gated-silence.wav
files.description: 5 s loud 1 kHz sine (amp 0.5), 40 s exact digital silence, 5 s same loud sine; absolute gate must exclude the silent blocks

files.name: quiet-passage.wav
files.description: 10 s loud 1 kHz sine (amp 0.5), 10 s quiet (amp 0.005, -46 dBFS), 10 s loud; exercises the relative gate

files.name: pink-ish.wav
files.description: deterministic Kellett-filtered noise, seeded LCG (seed 0xc10c), normalized to 0.2 peak; no Math.random anywhere

files.name: high-tone-11k.wav
files.description: honestly-labelled mid-high tone (renamed 2026-10-18; was "inter-sample-peak" with a wrong fnorm-0.5 worst-case claim): continuous 11.025 kHz sine amp 0.98, fnorm 0.2297, bound ~0.14 dB — NOT the Nyquist worst case; genuine near-Nyquist stress lives in the adversarial sweep

files.name: sine-1khz-loud.wav
files.description: companion control for high-tone-11k: uniform 1 kHz sine at amplitude 0.98, continuous 0-30 s. Same near-full-scale sample peak, but at 1 kHz (fnorm 0.042) the 4x detector under-read is negligible, so the limiter path is exercised where the detector is accurate — the contrast with the 11.025 kHz tone is the point. Settles like the other uniform tones.

files.name: mono-sine-1khz.wav
files.description: MONO worklet-path fixture: 1-channel WAV, 1 kHz sine amplitude 0.1 (~-20 dBFS peak), fed to the worklet as 1 channel (inputs[0] = [ch0]). Same level as sine-1khz-fs-20 so the 1-channel integrated loudness must agree with the ffmpeg 1-channel measurement within 0.1 LU.

files.name: comfort-quiet.wav
files.description: COMFORT cross-program quiet end: uniform 1 kHz sine amp 0.0447 (~-30 LUFS program). Must settle within +-0.5 LU of the -20 program target.

files.name: comfort-loud.wav
files.description: COMFORT cross-program loud end: uniform 1 kHz sine amp 0.447 (~-10 LUFS program). Must settle within +-0.5 LU of the -20 program target.

files.name: comfort-dialogue.wav
files.description: COMFORT long-form profile (YouTube-like: quiet dialogue against loud music/effects): 0-10 s loud 880 Hz sine amp 0.3, 10-20 s quiet 440 Hz sine amp 0.015, 20-30 s loud again. The levelling stage must shrink the loud:quiet spread by >= 3 dB and raise the quiet passage by >= 3 dB; ends with 10 s of stable loud program so the gain settles.

files.name: comfort-shortform.wav
files.description: COMFORT short-form profile (TikTok/X/Facebook/Reddit-like: wildly varying masters with hot peaks): 0-5 s amp 0.5, 5-10 s amp 0.025 (26 dB down: the quiet section gates out of the gated mean like dialogue, so the settled state is well-defined), 10-15 s amp 0.5 with 0.9-amp 64-frame Nyquist-alternating hot bursts at 11 s, 13 s and 14 s, 15-30 s stable amp 0.5 (15 s uniform stable tail: the settled steady state the oracle measures is one program, not a passage boundary).

files.name: comfort-varying4.wav
files.description: COMFORT dead-band NOT-fire case (EBU R 128 s4 clause k: within 5 LU no adaptation): 15 s sections alternating 440 Hz sine amp 0.1 / 0.0631 (4.0 dB, inLRA ~4.0 LU — a varying program that engages the processor, unlike a constant tone whose zero LRA stays zero under any compression and cannot fail). Section short-term sits inside the ±2.5 LU dead-band, so the levelling must apply NO adaptation: settled spread and tail LRA preserved.

files.name: comfort-pair12.wav
files.description: COMFORT dead-band FIRE case: 15 s sections alternating 440 Hz sine amp 0.2 / 0.05 (12.04 dB). Section short-term sits far outside the ±2.5 LU dead-band, so the levelling must engage: spread shrinks by >= 4 dB, the quiet section rises by >= 3 dB, residual spread stays >= 3 LU (OUR no-flatten floor — no published residual floor exists). The +6 dB published boost cap binds the quiet lift, so residual lands near 6 rather than exactly 5.

files.name: comfort-step.wav
files.description: COMFORT step-recovery profile (SPEC A5/H2/S4: 60 s quiet program followed by 30 s ~10 LU louder; the levelling/AGC stage must recover output short-term loudness to within +-1.0 LU of target within 10 s; a steady pre-step program must show no pumping). Quiet: 440 Hz sine amp 0.0447 (~-30 LUFS); loud: 440 Hz sine amp 0.1413 (~-20 LUFS, +10 dB). Ends with 30 s of stable loud program.

files.name: comfort-music.wav
files.description: COMFORT platform-normalized program profile (YT Music-like music program near the platforms’ ≈-14 delivery): uniform 440 Hz sine amp 0.2 (~-17 LUFS). The slow loop should apply a small attenuation of a few LU; the levelling stage should leave it nearly untouched (dead-band: no adaptation inside the band).

files.name: surround-51.wav
files.layout: SMPTE order L R C LFE Ls Rs; WAVEFORMATEXTENSIBLE mask 0x3F (FL|FR|FC|LFE|BL|BR)
files.description: 5.1 worklet-path fixture (6-channel WAV, SMPTE order L R C LFE Ls Rs, mask 0x3F): surrounds carry the energy (Ls/Rs: 1 kHz sine amp 0.5, weight 1.41 each — load-bearing), fronts carry little (L/R: 1 kHz amp 0.05; C: 1 kHz amp 0.02), LFE present and loud (50 Hz sine amp 0.5, weight 0 — must be excluded). A worklet that mis-weights surrounds or includes LFE mismatches ffmpeg by LU, not 0.0x. Fed to the worklet as 6 channels.
